Basis of the monitoring

Sources

The A–D scale indicates what a source establishes. Each letter describes a type of evidence. Accession probability is assessed separately.

A

Document

A legal act, an official register entry or a published agenda.

B

Official position

An official's statement or a joint political commitment.

C

Media report

A report, interview or assessment that requires attribution and verification.

D

Analytical conclusion

A conditional assessment of an event's impact on timing and scenarios.
